name: SampleDataTableNode
label: Sample Data Table
description: Returns a subset of rows from a data table, selected by count or percentage.
author: @aventisia

fields.name: SampleMode
fields.label: Sample Mode
fields.description: How the rows are selected (first N, last N, percentage, or random N).

selectOptions.label: First N Rows
selectOptions.description: Keeps the first N rows of the data table.

selectOptions.label: Last N Rows
selectOptions.description: Keeps the last N rows of the data table.

selectOptions.label: Percentage
selectOptions.description: Keeps a percentage of the rows (randomly selected).

selectOptions.label: Random N Rows
selectOptions.description: Keeps N rows selected at random.

fields.name: RowCount
fields.label: Row Count
fields.description: The number of rows to keep (used by First N, Last N, and Random N).

fields.name: Percentage
fields.label: Percentage
fields.description: The percentage of rows to keep (used by Percentage mode).

fields.name: SampledDataTable
fields.label: Sampled Data Table
fields.description: The resulting data table containing the sampled rows.
